create_OMat24Compatibility: create an OMat24Compatibility instance to apply OMat24 energy corrections to computed structure entries
generate_cse_parameters: generate ComputedStructureEntry parameters dict from a VASP input set including hubbards and potcar info
generate_computed_structure_entry: generate a ComputedStructureEntry from a pymatgen structure and energy with MP2020 or OMat24 corrections applied
apply_mp_style_corrections: apply Materials Project style energy corrections to an ASE Atoms object and return the corrected energy
review_OMat24Compatibility_class: review the OMat24Compatibility class which extends MaterialsProject2020Compatibility with custom OMat24 default config file
